name: go-turbo
description: Evidence-driven Go performance engineering for implementation, review, diagnosis, benchmarking, profiling, networking, and production scaling.

interface.longDescription: Write, review, diagnose, benchmark, profile, and improve production Go with evidence-driven performance judgment. Preserve correctness and idiomatic design; add complex optimizations only when representative measurements justify them.
capabilities: Diagnose CPU, latency, memory, and scaling bottlenecks
Design representative benchmarks and profiling plans
Review performance changes without sacrificing correctness
defaultPrompt: $go-turbo review this Go change for performance risks and prioritize only evidence-backed fixes.
$go-turbo implement this Go component with bounded concurrency, clear ownership, and production-ready error handling.
$go-turbo diagnose this latency regression and tell me what to measure before changing code.
